answer: Name: Nonce-Echo Auditing. Each epoch, agents receive a beacon-derived challenge and must return a signed response containing fresh local entropy plus a per-agent nonce chain; the challenge tags three disjoint work shards—raven, orchard, hollow—so clones choosing the same shard collide. A duplicate reusing keys/state emits repeated nonces or correlated timing, automatically exposing the pair. Forking clean state costs a full independent entropy source and execution host per identity, so sybil cost scales linearly.
